name: relevo-monorepo
description: RELEVO: Pay across currencies. Verify without internet.

scripts.dev:all: node --run dev:all 2>/dev/null || (npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend)
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run test --workspace=shared && npm run test --workspace=backend
